name: teal-flash-cutout-collage
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· PHOTOGRAPHY: a hard direct on-camera-flash studio portrait, glossy dewy skin, wet catch-lights, over-sharp, then cut out cleanly and pasted into a digital collage.
· GROUND: one flat matte solid teal / turquoise field, completely empty, cut-paper collage space.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: scrapbook cut-out collage — the subject and small props float as separate clipped pieces with crisp knife-cut edges, arranged with airy negative space around them.
· LIGHT: harsh frontal flash flattening the subject, blown highlights on skin, small hard shadows.
· PALETTE: bright teal background against warm skin tone, with saturated candy pops of magenta-pink, red and acid yellow on the props.
· MOOD: playful, kitschy, cheeky Y2K poster energy.
· GRAIN: sharp and clean with a faint print-noise texture over the flat colour field.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
